item.title: Agentic Loops and Agent Graphs: Security Risks You Need to Know
item.content:encoded: Most AI agent security advice focuses on the model. But the real risks come from the architecture choices you make as a developer: whether to use an agentic loop or a multi-agent graph. Here's what changes when you do.
